Thanks for checking. Here's how it works on our side: once a successfully-imported file's rows have been written to the ledger, the original uploaded file is deleted from storage immediately (see the import worker's processJob, which calls storage.remove right after completing the job). The only files retained are those from *failed* imports, which are kept for up to 7 days (FAILED_UPLOAD_RETENTION_DAYS in src/ingest/worker.ts) so the original file can be inspected for debugging, after which a periodic purge job removes them automatically. Nothing needs to change here, just sharing details for your security review.
